source_policy.fallback_rule: GitHub/yfinance, FinMind and TAIFEX may fill null fields only when the observation belongs to the same specified trade date/session date. Never silently overwrite a non-null canonical value or use a different trade date.
source_policy.trade_date_rule: Latest completed U.S. cash session is 2026-08-31. Taiwan cash/FX/OI latest completed session is 2026-08-31. TAIFEX after-hours physical window 2026-08-31 15:00–2026-09-01 05:00 is attributed to session_trade_date 2026-09-01.
source_policy.uncertainty_rule: When exact same-session data are not independently verified, retain null and flag validation_required. Different-date observations must never be blended.

DXY.source: ICE Dollar Index via Investing/Gate market data

SOX.source: MT Newswires reported PHLX Semiconductor Index +0.5% at close; exact Nasdaq closing level not independently verified before cutoff

taiwan_futures.change_basis: vs 2026-08-31 regular-session TX close 45983; Yahoo quote itself displayed +1 vs prior after-hours reference, so do not mix bases.
taiwan_futures.source: Yahoo Taiwan Futures latest near-month quote for after-hours close; Economic Daily for regular close and foreign net OI
taiwan_futures.note: Exact TAIFEX after-hours OHLC/volume and total contract OI were not independently verified before cutoff. GitHub may fill only session_trade_date 2026-09-01 after-hours values and 2026-08-31 regular OI values; never carry older OI.

finviz.rule: Capture fresh at render time; warn on trade-date mismatch.

sector_rotation.rule: Require 2026-08-31 U.S. trade date; do not reuse older sector output.

taiwan_rotation.rule: Use latest completed 2026-08-31 Taiwan cash session for local price confirmation; institutional/margin fields remain explicit when unavailable.

breaking_news.headline: U.S.-Iran hostilities lift oil and inflation risk
breaking_news.summary: Renewed attacks around the Strait of Hormuz pushed U.S. crude above $85 and Brent above $90 while U.S. equities closed lower.
breaking_news.market_impact: Oil shock plus hawkish Fed pricing pushed the 10-year yield near a 52-week high.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Higher oil/yields pressure high-duration tech while supporting energy/shipping themes.

breaking_news.headline: NVIDIA invests $3.5B in MediaTek, expands partnership
breaking_news.summary: NVIDIA will invest $3.5 billion in MediaTek convertible bonds and deepen collaboration in AI chips, PCs and vehicles using NVLink Fusion.
breaking_news.market_impact: Supports custom AI silicon and rack-scale ecosystem expansion.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Direct positive read-through for MediaTek and Taiwan AI/advanced-packaging ecosystem; watch TSMC capacity implications.

breaking_news.headline: EU orders AI supercomputer using AMD chips
breaking_news.summary: EuroHPC awarded Bull a EUR387.8M LUMI-AI contract integrating AMD AI chips, IBM storage and Nokia networking.
breaking_news.market_impact: Shows sovereign AI compute demand remains capacity-constrained and diversifies accelerator demand beyond NVIDIA.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Positive demand signal for foundry/packaging and AI-server supply chains.

breaking_news.headline: U.S.-Taiwan high-tech ties highlighted ahead of SEMICON
breaking_news.summary: Top U.S. diplomat in Taipei emphasized Taiwan's role in U.S. semiconductor re-industrialization, including TSMC's Arizona investment.
breaking_news.market_impact: Reinforces strategic importance of Taiwan semiconductor capacity.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Constructive for TSMC and equipment ecosystems, though tariff/policy risk remains.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: NVIDIA puts $3.5B behind MediaTek partnership
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: MediaTek customers can use NVIDIA NVLink Fusion for custom AI chips; partnership extends into PCs and AI vehicles.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: NVDA +1.48%, AMD +1.10%, while TSM ADR -0.53%; semiconductor breadth improved despite broad-market weakness.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Raises focus on MediaTek, advanced packaging, high-speed interconnect and foundry capacity.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: AMD selected for EU LUMI-AI expansion
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: The EU's next AI supercomputer will use AMD AI chips as Europe expands AI Factories capacity.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Supports alternative accelerator demand and sovereign AI capex.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Positive for Taiwan foundry/packaging/server components tied to AMD platforms.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Apple diverges from chip rebound
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Apple fell 0.89% while NVIDIA and AMD rose.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Watch device-supply-chain orders rather than extrapolating semiconductor beta.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: AI monetization broadens while yields pressure mega-cap valuations
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Public reporting said ChatGPT Ads reached about $1B annualized revenue run-rate while Microsoft fell 1.22%.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: AI revenue vectors broaden even as discount-rate pressure remains.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Hardware read-through still depends on datacenter capex and deployment.

AI server demand/backlog and margins test
major_earnings.guidance: Consensus around revenue $45.2B and adjusted EPS $4.91.

narration_points: 美伊衝突再升溫，WTI跳升到85美元附近，通膨與Fed升息風險重新壓過月末行情。
四大指數同步收低，但Nasdaq僅小跌0.12%；NVIDIA與AMD反而上漲，顯示AI硬體由全面殺估值轉為個股分化。
NVIDIA斥35億美元投資聯發科，是今日台灣AI供應鏈最直接的新催化。
10年債殖利率逼近52週高點，VIX回到15附近，高估值科技股風險尚未解除。
台股8/31盤中重挫後拉回，台指期日盤收45983；最新夜盤約45978接近平盤，但官方同session OHLC/總OI仍待TAIFEX同日驗證。
今天開始進入JOLTS、ISM、Dell/Palo Alto，再到Broadcom與週五非農的連續驗證窗口。
